device.name: Pointfoot blind flat locomotion task (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim)

facts.text: This repository is used to train and simulate bipedal robots such as the limxdynamics TRON1
The project targets Isaac Sim 4.2.0 and Isaac Lab 1.4.0
The extension is installed with python -m pip install -e exts/bipedal_locomotion using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed
The training command selects the registered task Isaac-PF-Blind-Flat-v0
Real-robot deployment is delegated to the external rl-deploy-with-python repository's mlp branch
Isaac-PF-Blind-Flat-v0 is registered with the external entry point omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and env_cfg_entry_point pointfoot_env_cfg.PFBlindFlatEnvCfg
The flat task inherits PFBaseEnvCfg and sets the height scanner, the policy and critic heights observations and the terrain-level curriculum to None
The pointfoot base environment sets the robot to POINTFOOT_CFG and the six leg joint initial positions to 0.0, 0.0, 0.0918, 0.0918, -0.057 and -0.057
POINTFOOT_CFG's initial state names the six leg joints plus foot_L_Joint and foot_R_Joint, eight joints in all
The action term is a joint-position action over the six named leg joints with scale 0.25 and use_default_offset True
The base velocity command has heading_command True
The base velocity command ranges are lin_vel_x -1.0 to 1.0, lin_vel_y -0.5 to 0.5, ang_vel_z -1 to 1 and heading -pi to pi
The gait command ranges are frequency 1.5 to 2.5 Hz, offset 0.5 and duration 0.5, resampled every 5.0 s
The policy observation terms in order are base angular velocity, projected gravity, joint positions, joint velocities, last action, velocity command, gait phase and gait command
The policy observation group concatenates its terms, enables corruption and uses history_length 5 with flatten_history_dim True
The simulation advances by sim.dt 0.005 s, the control decimation is 4, an episode is 20.0 s long and the configured seed is 42
The episode ends through the time_out term or an illegal contact of base_Link above a threshold of 1.0
get_gait_phase returns the gait phase as [sin(phase), cos(phase)] with shape (num_envs, 2)
get_gait_command returns the gait command parameters [frequency, offset, duration] with shape (num_envs, 3)

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's command draws and the kinematic update is deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeat a trajectory; the upstream Isaac Lab and PhysX random streams are not used and no trajectory was compared with the upstream environment

gaps: kinematic model: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors, terrain or noise model; the six joint targets are mapped to positions without a physics engine

the policy observation is a 185-value stand-in built from the clone's eight observation terms, the eight named joints and history_length 5 (base_env_cfg.py:128-154); observation corruption, command resampling, the gait-phase computation and the real Isaac Lab observation space were not observed, and the joint positions, joint velocities, commands, gait values and reward are placeholders

the real action-space bounds were not observed: the clone configures no action clip, and the bounds come from the external ManagerBasedRLEnv / JointPositionAction implementation, so the fake's action Box is unbounded
the illegal base_contact termination, the reward terms and the PhysX sensor and actuator models are not modelled
the upstream simulator needs Isaac Sim 4.2.0 and Isaac Lab 1.4.0 with a GPU (README.md:7-8) and was not installed or run; the sim backend and the registered task were not run
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state stays readable
